summary_en: Proposes a frequency-domain phase-delay inversion imaging method for low-velocity impact damage in anisotropic CFRP laminates. Spatially dependent phase compensation accounts for guided-wave dispersion and skewing, after which coherent superposition creates virtual focusing at scattering locations for damage imaging.
